blocker_B1.summary: ADR-5's four-handler set is dead code. PointerCaptureBoundary binds onPointerDownCapture on an ANCESTOR and calls preventDefault()+stopPropagation() in the CAPTURE phase, so the join button's onPointerDown/onMouseDown/onClick never execute. pointerup then yields {type:'click'} and the event form opens; native click still fires so window.open also runs. Net effect: join click opens BOTH a new tab and the event form.
